newsitem.title: USA: Merrill files for $300 mln pref. securities.
newsitem.headline: Merrill files for $300 mln pref. securities.

text.p: A business trust formed by Merrill Lynch & Co said Wednesday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $300 million of trust originated preferred securities.
The trust, known as Merrill Lynch Preferred Capital Trust II, will use the proceeds from the offering to invest in subordinated debentures and eligible debt securities.
Merrill intends to use the proceeds from the sale of the debentures for general corporate purposes and to repay certain intercompany indebtedness.
The 12 million trust preferred securities have a liquidation amount of $25 per trust preferred security, the filing said.
